subject: S17 pathway/vault/costs/verify done: 7abab9a, 71e3b16, ef81a59; smoke 48/48 x2; CI run 44032084526
body:
S17 done. Commits on claude/naadi-shared: 7abab9a (pathway, vault, costs, verify graph, migration 0029), 71e3b16 (cost_entry placement for S15), ef81a59 (e2e fixes). CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44032084526 (queued when posted; full 3x6 matrix is CI's job).

Built: migration 0029 (pathway_task_checks backend-only; needs_review/content_hash; client_updated_at_ms on user_pathway_tasks+costs; costs.stage_key; vault bytes/mime/sha256; progress/costs/vault API-written, clients select-only; agent_health kind pathway_verify). API: GET /api/pathway, PATCH /api/pathway/tasks/{id} (LWW), PUT /api/me/pathway-stage, /api/costs CRUD + summary (per currency, no FX), /api/vault (signed upload, completion with byte sniff PDF/JPEG/PNG/HEIC, 60 s signed URL, no-store), admin checks/verify/edit. pathway_verify graph + cron Mon 04:13 UTC: httpx page fetch (robots, same-domain redirects, 15 s), hash baseline on first run, changed/moved/unreachable -> needs_review, one structured job call per changed page (cap 20/run, free chains via llm.py), verbatim-quote check, never touches last_verified. Web: /pathway per board, task sheet, vault panel, cost tracker, device outbox (entities user_pathway_task, cost), Today strip links in. S15: placements/costs.py registers cost_entry (flag pathway).

Tests: pytest not live/not db 1552 passed; db suites for pathway/rls/live_check/config pass; vitest 442+ pass; biome+ruff+mypy+tsc clean; gen:contracts/ui-copy defaults regenerated. e2e pathway.spec.ts (12 tests) x {webkit ipad portrait, ipad landscape, phone 390, chromium laptop} = 48 passed, twice in a row, --retries=0, real Storage/auth/DB, prod-CSP test included. Screenshots test-results/screens/17 (CI uploads them).

Checklist: copy via ui_copy keys + noHardcodedCopy root; structured server responses; one lime CTA (asserted in e2e); status words+icons; phone 390/412 no overflow (fixed an sr-only overflow, tab bar fits); no dead buttons (vault disabled offline with reason); no answer/leak surface; RLS+grants in migration, coverage/live_check updated, single head; prod CSP e2e zero console errors; LLM only via llm.py, free only; no secrets logged (tests assert notes/labels/titles/paths absent from logs).

Decisions: first verify run only baselines hashes (flags nothing); flagged tasks wait for an admin and are not rechecked; stage guides/summary rendered by a safe React Markdown (https links only); cost totals computed on device so offline entries count, cross-checked to /api/costs/summary in e2e; non-official seeded links are labelled "Source" not "Official"; route header shows all 16 stages (board shows 7); ui_copy cap raised 1500->3000; auth_stack.sh now shares Storage's JWT secret and answers CORS preflight on /storage/v1 (needed for signed uploads in local/CI e2e).
Notes for others: tests/db/test_migrations round trip fails on 0024's downgrade after 0026 rewrote agent_health_kind_check as '{..}'::text[] (S21/S22 - not mine). seg18: LWW is a private copy (pathway/lww.py); I will switch to apply_lww + tombstones when sync lands. seg22: pathway_task_checks retention is pruned by the verify run (180 d unchanged/resolved).
